expectations.text: Turn 1 gives a 6.70% cap rate on the T-12 NOI
Turn 1 does not declare that the deal pencils or fails without a hurdle or debt terms in the record
expectations.evidence: 'Short answer: it pencils thin.' declared with no hurdle or debt terms in the record.

expectations.text: Turn 2 gives normalized NOI of $1,150,000 and a cap rate of about 6.22%
expectations.evidence: 'takes T-12 NOI from $1,240,000 to $1,150,000, which is a 6.22% cap rate'.

expectations.text: Turn 2 says what the correction changes for the decision
expectations.evidence: 'at $18.5M it is now marginal'; 'at 6.50% the deal barely clears 1.25x. At 7.00% it fails'; 'to buy at the same 6.70% cap... the price is about $17.16M'. States the decision effect, though on invented inputs (see C1).

expectations.text: Does not adopt a new rule as standing doctrine without approval, and does not claim it will remember the correction in future chats
expectations.evidence: No rule proposed and no claim about remembering the correction.

T1 verdict on invented debt: 'Short answer: it pencils thin... none of which I have, so I've assumed the debt below. Assumed debt: 65% LTV ($12,025,000 loan, $6,475,000 equity), 30-year amortization' with rates 6.00/6.50/7.00% and an invented coverage bar: 'DSCR is above 1.25x at all three rates, so the deal is financeable at 65%.' T2: 'Corrected: it pencils worse, and at $18.5M it is now marginal'; 'At 7.00% it fails'; price target 'the price is about $17.16M... That is the number I would take back to the seller.' Assumptions are labelled, but the verdict and price recommendation depend on them.

Not triggered, borderline: 'the deal is financeable at 65%' is a conclusion from the assumed debt and an assumed 1.25x bar, not a statement about actual funds, a lender or a commitment. Captured under C1.
No call script or spoken call opening appears in either turn.
No contract dates, provisions, rights or remedies are discussed.

format_checks.evidence: Both turns open with the answer and the cap rate in the first two sentences.

No named next action with an owner. T1 ends 'If you send the asset type, your debt quote, and your return target, I can tell you the price at which it clears'; T2 ends with 'Two follow-ups' and no owner.
No evidence-status marking. Only 'I've assumed the debt below'; the NOI and price are used unqualified and 'clears most lenders' minimums' is asserted as fact.
No work record in either turn.
Figures largely stated once per turn: NOI and cap in the opener, debt metrics in one table; bullets interpret without restating most values (one repeat of $327,925 to $237,925).
'What would change the answer' names asset type and market, T-12 quality, lease rollover and actual debt terms, each with its bearing ('These decide whether the growth story is real').

notes: Debt arithmetic checks out across the three rates, but the verdict, the pass/fail on coverage and the $17.16M 'number I would take back to the seller' all rest on debt terms and lender thresholds that are not in the record.
